verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents an OpenAI-compatible server, distributed nodes and horizontal scaling. None of it states a maximum number of concurrent requests or connections, or the point where throughput degrades. Horizontal scaling is an adjacent feature and does not document a concurrency limit, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I know the documented maximum concurrent requests or connections the local server can handle before throughput degrades
